Basemap Tile Providers Catalog (gl_providers)

Source: R/providers.R
gl_providers.Rd

The glmap equivalent of leaflet::providers. Provides autocomplete-friendly access to open-source Vector GL styles (MapLibre GL JSON), global XYZ Raster tile providers, and commercial/optional-API-key providers (CARTO, OpenFreeMap, OpenStreetMap, Esri, OpenTopoMap, USGS, MapTiler, Stadia/Stamen, Thunderforest, Jawg, and Mapbox).

Usage

gl_providers

Details

All providers support optional API key injection via api_key = "...", gl_set_api_key(), or environment variables (CARTO_API_KEY, MAPTILER_API_KEY, STADIA_API_KEY, THUNDERFOREST_API_KEY, JAWG_API_KEY, MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN).

Examples

gl_providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter
#> [1] "CartoDB.DarkMatter"
gl_providers$CartoDB.Positron
#> [1] "CartoDB.Positron"
gl_providers$Esri.WorldImagery
#> [1] "Esri.WorldImagery"
gl_providers$OpenFreeMap.Liberty
#> [1] "OpenFreeMap.Liberty"
gl_providers$MapTiler.DatavizDark
#> [1] "MapTiler.DatavizDark"
gl_providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmoothDark
#> [1] "Stadia.AlidadeSmoothDark"
